title: wslua: Debugger: Tie Locals/Upvalues to selected stack frame
description:
Choosing a row in the call stack now updates the Locals and Upvalues
shown in the Variables panel. Brief tooltips explain stack selection and
what each variable group means. After Evaluate, the stack and variables
views refresh in a sensible order.

Ping #21193

AI-Assisted: yes

     WS_DLL_PUBLIC void wslua_debugger_step_out(void);
 
+    /**
+     * @brief Set which call stack frame supplies Locals and Upvalues in the
+     *        variables view.

+     */
